correctness.rationale: Parsed actual frozen RESULT.md and checker.py. Prefix statistics (a,b,c,d) for 0,00,001,0011 obey T0=(a+1,b+a,c,d), T1=(a,b,c+b,d+c) modulo m. After t zeros (a,b)=(t,C(t,2)), giving m first-two pairs for odd m and 2m for even m. The words U=1 and W=1^(m-1)0010^(2m-2) independently generate all (c,d) on the zero-phase fiber, and 0^t reaches each phase; suffixes epsilon,1,11,011 recover d,c,b,a exactly. The argument proves upper, reachability and lower bounds for all m>=2, not by finite extrapolation. An independent BFS over complete transitions verified m^3*gcd(m,2) reachable and four-suffix distinguishable states for all 2<=m<=19.
